fields.to: Darnell Hughes, Incident Commander; Victor Anand, OT Engineer
fields.subject: FW: [URGENT] SIS Integrity Confirmation — TVC-JMP-02 Session
fields.note: This is a direct confirmation from Ridgeline Automation. CISA and FBI have validated the compromise. The SIS logic was modified without MOC approval. The remote session from TVC-JMP-02 was not logged. The Triconex key switch was in PROGRAM mode. The system is compromised. Do not reset. The ERT has confirmed the hand valve HV-312 is open and the release continues. We recommend: manually close HV-312 via local panel at Rail Spot 2. All automated commands must be disabled.
fields.signature:
Ridgeline Automation Support
Engineering Response Team
